speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Prolonged Breastfeeding Jaundice)

The baby is 2 weeks old, exclusively breastfed, and has a weight gain of 134g over the last week, which suggests adequate intake but delayed excretion of bilirubin due to low frequency of effective feeding. Given the timing (after day 2), breast milk history, and good weight gain, this fits the profile of breastfeeding-associated jaundice rather than dehydration or sepsis. However, I need to confirm the severity of the hyperbilirubinemia before finalizing the plan.
